## Overview

This is the **Spring PetClinic REST** app (Maven, Java, Spring Boot + OfficeFloor). The "owner identity" logic lives in a pipeline of small single-purpose function classes under `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`, wired into the response via a MapStruct mapper and an OpenAPI-generated `OwnerDto`.

### 1. `identityKey` — duplicate-detection key
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKey.java`
- `IdentityKey.of(Owner)` (line 23) = SHA-256 hex of `telephone(E.164) + '|' + email(lowercased, empty if absent) + '|' + Soundex.of(lastName)`.
- Note: the class Javadoc and the OpenAPI description (line 2144) say the key is `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`, but the **actual code** uses `Soundex.of(lastName)` as the third component, not `householdId`. That is a spec/impl discrepancy worth noting.
- Helpers `telephone()` (line 27, via `E164Telephone.toE164`) and `email()` (line 32).

### 2. `householdId` — stable household identifier
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdId.java`
- `HouseholdId.of(Owner)` (line 22) = first 12 UPPER-hex chars (6 bytes) of SHA-256 over `normalize(lastName) + '|' + postcode`.
- `normalize()` (line 38): trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase. Keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`, stateless.
- Note: OpenAPI description (line 2138) says "same last name and address"; code uses **postcode**, not full address.

### 3. `HouseholdSize` — member count
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdSize.java`
- `HouseholdSize.of(Owner, OwnerRepository)` (line 16): counts owners (incl. self) sharing the same `HouseholdId` by scanning `repository.findAll()`.

### 4. `memberId` — unified customer code (region + fiscal year + hash + check digit)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`
- `service(@Val Owner)` (line 20): sets `customerCode = Locality.of(owner) + FiscalYear.yy(owner) + hash8(owner)`, then appends `CheckDigit.of(owner)`.
- `hash8()` (line 25): first 8 UPPER-hex chars of SHA-256 over `telephone + lastName` (raw telephone, NOT E.164-normalized here).
- Format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, e.g. `NSW271A2B3C4D5`. Stored in the `customerCode` slot; the mapper exposes it as `memberId`.

Supporting derivations for memberId:
- **Region code**: `Locality.of(owner)` (see #7 below).
- **Fiscal year**: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java` — `of(LocalDate)` (line 18, FY starts 1 July, numbered by ending year), `label()` → `FY27` (line 23, feeds DTO `fiscalYear`), `yy()` → `27` (line 28, feeds memberId).

- Schema source: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, `Owner:` schema at **lines 2085–2254** (extends `OwnerFields`). - Mapper that populates the DTO: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
  - `toOwnerDto(Owner)` (line 30) with MapStruct `@Mapping` expressions: `householdId` (line 23), `identityKey` (line 24), `memberId` = `owner.getCustomerCode()` (line 25), `fiscalYear` (line 26), plus `displayName`, `initials`, `ageBand`, `telephoneDisplay`, `salutation`.

Build tool: **Maven** (via the wrapper `./mvnw`). - `./mvnw test` (or `./mvnw clean install` / `./mvnw verify`).

- `java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — the only actual `@Test` class. `coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions()` (line 11) asserts `$.apiVersion == 2` and that `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId` live under a nested `$.identity` object and are absent at top level.
- `java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — black-box MockMvc base (`@SpringBootTest`, `@AutoConfigureMockMvc`, `@Transactional`, `@WithMockUser`). - `java/.../acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — `AutoCloseable` helper that attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `AUDIT` logger (line 31) so tests can assert the structured `OWNER_CREATED` event from `SaveOwner`; methods `messages()` (41), `anyContains()` (45), `anyAtLevel()` (57), `count()` (71).

1. `IdentityKey` code uses `Soundex(lastName)` as its third segment, while both its own Javadoc and the OpenAPI `identityKey` description claim `householdId`.
2. `HouseholdId` keys on `(lastName, postcode)` while the OpenAPI description says "last name and address."
3. The `identity-v2` acceptance test (`apiVersion`, nested `identity`) has no corresponding schema/mapper/response support yet — it describes a target state, not the current implementation.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On read this is the composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a space and addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; supply this or 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner, stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-02'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: Optional date of birth of the pet owner. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner; set true by DELETE, which retains the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, e.g. 'J.S.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region code, the 2-digit fiscal year, the 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', e.g. 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered by its ending calendar year, e.g. 'FY27' for 1 July 2026 - 30 June 2027.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent); two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive), counted just before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points - starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The region derived from the owner's city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone derived from the owner's region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent for any other region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today (by registration date), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when 40 to 49 other owners already share this owner's city (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner shares this owner's last name and postcode but has a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard duplicate), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of; absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate, the email domain is disposable-adjacent (a known disposable domain or a subdomain of one), or the city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred way to contact this owner - 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: Age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate - 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true

              format: int32

              example: false

              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, e.g. 'J.S.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract. Always 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's version-2 identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId), each derived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' tag so no value produced under version 1 recurs.
              type: object
              readOnly: true
              properties:
                memberId:
                  title: Member ID
                  description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the version-2 region code (the plain region prefixed with the 'V2' tag), the 2-digit fiscal year, the 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', e.g. 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'.
                  type: string
                  example: 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'
                  readOnly: true
                householdId:
                  title: Household ID
                  description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household), derived with the version-2 algorithm.
                  type: string
                  example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
                  readOnly: true
                identityKey:
                  title: Identity key
                  description: Derived duplicate-detection key over the normalized telephone, email and Soundex of the last name, derived with the version-2 algorithm; two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys are equal.
                  type: string
                  example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2'
                  readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year

              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent); two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys are equal.

              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive), counted just before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points - starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              title: Membership level

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2

              readOnly: true

              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today (by registration date), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when 40 to 49 other owners already share this owner's city (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
